decisions.reason: Because Product A builds directly on the firm’s established laser marking knowledge, the firm can interpret its early results and improve it, making withdrawal unlikely.
Because Product B is close to the firm’s existing coding and marking technologies, the firm has the absorptive capacity to learn from its market feedback and further develop it, so it will keep it.
Because Product C also leverages the firm’s related inkjet and marking know-how and in-house R&D, the firm can assimilate its early performance and apply improvements, making a drop improbable.
